name: therpay_benchmarking
description: Therpay_benchmarking evaluates LLMs on their ability to produce therapeutic, supportive, and clinically appropriate conversational responses. The benchmark measures empathy, safety, and adherence to clinical guidance across curated patient-simulator dialogues and prompts. It emphasizes avoidance of harmful advice and quality of psychoeducational content.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited adoption, primarily used in healthcare and safety-focused NLP research.
